title: Curve Using Prelookup
text: Use previously calculated index and fraction values to accelerate approximation of one-dimensional function, 1 input, 1 output, {Table data} sets Data type of table data Inherit: Same as; {Targeted Routine Library} Indicates the AUTOSAR routine library used for block code replacement, {Targeted Routine} sets the aUTOSAR library routine used for code replacement, {Data Specification} sets how to enter table data, {Name}, {Edit table and breakpoints} sets the launch Lookup Table Editor dialog box, {Interpolation method} selects Linear point-slope or Flat interpolation methods Linear and {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point or floating-point operations. Values come from the instance.
